sourceUsedThisBatch: NAPLAN 2016 final test papers: Year 3 Numeracy, Year 3 Language Conventions, Year 5 Numeracy, Year 5 Language Conventions, plus the official 2016 Year 3 and Year 5 paper-test-answers keys.
licenseAndAccess: Free to access, no login required, hosted directly on ACARA's own domain (acara.edu.au / acaraweb.blob.core.windows.net). ACARA's past-papers pages state these are made available for personal/educational download, print and copy use; ACARA does not release papers after 2016. Per this pipeline's standing policy (style-inspired, not verbatim -- see ingestion_pipeline_design.md), Step 3 rewrote every item's wording, numbers, names and option order regardless of the underlying license, so this batch does not depend on resolving the free-to-access-vs-free-to-reuse distinction in our favour.
readingTestNotProcessed: The Year 3 and Year 5 Reading tests were downloaded but deliberately not extracted from, per a known, previously-documented gap in this pipeline (see research/pipeline/README.md, 'What changed from the original design' / 'Passage-based reading comprehension has no destination format yet'): data/seed/english.json only supports standalone grammar/vocabulary items, with no `passage` field and no way to group several questions under one shared reading text. Writing was also excluded entirely -- it is constructed-response with no fixed answer key, out of scope for this pipeline by standing rule.
duplicateNumeracyAndLanguageConventionsI: NAPLAN reuses a number of identical items verbatim between the Year 3 and Year 5 2016 papers (e.g. the balance-scale cube-weight item, the 'four thousand and thirty-seven kilometres' item, Henry's 12x6 apples item, Shana's $30 shopping item, Ari's number-clue item, the apples-fraction-sharing item, and at least 7 identical Language Conventions grammar items). Where a Numeracy or Language Conventions item was found to be textually identical (or near-identical with only trivial value changes) between the two year levels, it was extracted and logged once against its first occurrence (Year 3) and the Year 5 duplicate was recorded as skipped, to avoid manufacturing two near-duplicate entries in the seed data from what is really one source item. See 01-extracted-classified.json's `skipped` list for the specific duplicate pairs.

priorBlockedAttempt_preservedForRecord.status: BLOCKED -- Step 0 did not clear for this source specifically. No extraction was ever performed from it. No content was fabricated.
findings: The NAP public demonstration site's marketing/info pages are live and genuinely describe a free, no-login demo test.

The actual interactive test delivery platform (pages.assessform.edu.au / assessform.edu.au) is protected by bot-detection / WAF middleware that returned an explicit block page to both WebFetch and a real Chrome browser session automated via claude-in-chrome.

Separately and independently of the block: the demo site's own text states 'answers are not provided' for its tests, so even with access there would have been no official answer key for that specific source.
priorBlockedAttempt_preservedForRecord.conclusion: This specific source (the interactive demo platform) remains unreached and was not attempted again in this run, per explicit task instruction not to try to bypass bot detection.
